I replied to Marcus in the #north-random thread. I noted the Thornbury Cloth Co. signed order form deadline as 15 August, as he asked.

I also pointed out that today is 14 October, so 15 August has already passed. I asked him to tell me if the ops lead meant a different date.

I couldn't find the earlier post he's correcting in the recent #north-random history. The last day of messages there is only the sandwich run and fantasy football. A signing date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat in the channel. No other action was needed.
